      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches src/ipc/libmultiprocess and src/ipc/capnp infrastructure, adding native cancellation support to proxy generation and IPC RPC handling.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "It adds native request cancellation support to libmultiprocess and IPC proxy generation, allowing clients to cancel blocking calls by dropping response promises. Per ryanofsky's review, this enables simpler and more efficient cancellation without issuing out-of-band IPC calls."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled Mining and modifies interfaces::Mining and Cap'n Proto mining definitions in src/interfaces/mining.h and src/ipc/capnp/mining.capnp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "It replaces clumsy out-of-band interrupt methods with cancellation arguments on blocking mining interface methods like waitTipChanged and waitNext, resolving RFC #33575. This stabilizes and streamlines the interface relied upon by external mining consumers such as Stratum v2 template providers."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches test/functional/test_framework/ipc_util.py to support testing the IPC mining cancellation changes.",
